summary: A signed raw-radial-velocity divergence coefficient is identifiable only conditionally on an externally frozen Hubble calibration, a full-rank distance/sky window, and successful leakage/coverage injections. The primary Tsagas relation maps scalar divergence to a scalar local deceleration correction; it does not supply a bulk-flow apex or a q-dipole response. Therefore a q-dipole comparison requires a separately authenticated response operator and a valid same-realization cross-channel covariance. Missing either, or a near-rigid-translation/rank failure, forces NON_INFORMATIVE.

forbidden_uses: bulk-flow apex inference from scalar divergence
joint evidence or significance without a valid cross-channel covariance
replacement of divergence by bulk-flow speed without labeling an approximation

assumptions_and_conventions.regime: linear, non-relativistic peculiar velocity on sub-Hubble, approximately flat, pressureless almost-FLRW scales; no nonlinear or native-solver claim

frames.peculiar_velocity: radial peculiar velocity relative to the CMB/Hubble frame
frames.source_quantity: tilde_vartheta = tilde_D_a tilde_v^a in the tilted frame; the low-z Euclidean radial estimator is a declared linear kinematic proxy, not an exact light-cone GR observable
frames.hard_gate: CMB, heliocentric, Local Group, reconstruction, and geometry-frame quantities may not be mixed

units.distance: physical Mpc, never Mpc/h in the derivative design

hubble_calibration.primary: H_ref = 74.6 km/s/Mpc, matching the authenticated CF4 raw-velocity definition already used by cf4_velocity_estimators.py
hubble_calibration.rule: H_ref is externally fixed for this estimand and is not fitted from the same radial-distance data
hubble_calibration.exact_degeneracy: because y_i = V3k_i - H_ref r_i and the divergence design column is g_i=r_i/3, H_ref -> H_ref+delta_H implies theta_hat -> theta_hat-3 delta_H (for fixed distances/window). Jointly fitting H_ref and theta from these data is rank-deficient.
hubble_calibration.consequence: any alternative H_ref is a separately labeled sensitivity estimand requiring complete recomputation; mixing the CF4 74.6 velocity construction with the 67.36 default in tilted_flrw.py invalidates the cross-channel result

scales.scale_convention: lambda=2R is the physical diameter of the drifting domain; all three scales and their order are frozen before output
scales.anti_drift: no scale, shell edge, axis, or sign may be chosen after inspecting coherence

sources.title: The deceleration parameter in tilted Friedmann universes: Newtonian vs relativistic treatment
verified_points: u_a is the CMB/Hubble frame and tilde_u_a the tilted/peculiar-motion frame
tilde_Theta = Theta + tilde_vartheta and tilde_H = H + tilde_vartheta/3 at linear order
tilde_q = q + (1/3)(1+Omega/2)(tilde_vartheta_prime/dot_H) is the general linear frame relation
the sub-horizon correction has the sign of tilde_vartheta: expanding flow raises tilde_q and contracting flow lowers it

sources.version: primary author paper; version of record DOI 10.1140/epjc/s10052-021-09515-9
sources.title: The peculiar Jeans length
verified_points: Eq. 13: tilde_q_(n) = q + (1/9)(lambda_H/lambda_n)^2 tilde_vartheta_(n)/H on sub-horizon scales
Eq. 14-15: the critical scale uses absolute divergence only for the magnitude threshold; the signed q correction remains signed
Eq. 21 is explicitly an approximation because surveys provide mean speed rather than divergence: tilde_vartheta approximately +/-sqrt(3)<tilde_v>/lambda
the paper explicitly says divergence is difficult to extract because higher moments of the noisy velocity field have systematic uncertainty

primary_source_verification.auditor_conclusion: The exact theoretical carrier is signed divergence, not speed or rapidity. The repository Delta_q(beta,d) substitutes the extra closure |theta|/H=beta lambda_H/d, discards the contraction/expansion sign, and is not the exact Tsagas equation. The primary speed substitution is itself approximate and convention-dependent (including a sqrt(3) factor in the cited primary treatment).

equations.kinematic_decomposition: v(x)=B+[(theta/3)I+S+Omega]x+O(|x|^2), with tr(S)=0 and Omega antisymmetric
equations.radial_rotation_no_go: n_i^T Omega (r_i n_i)=0, so central radial velocities do not identify the antisymmetric/curl part of a first-order affine field
equations.source_domain: the map is a conditional sub-horizon almost-FLRW scalar relation; it is not a q-dipole or apex map
dimension_checks: g_i=r_i/3 has Mpc and theta has km/s/Mpc, so g_i theta is km/s
theta/H_ref and c/(H_ref lambda) are dimensionless

estimator.inputs: authenticated raw CF4 distance/redshift/group rows only; reconstruction columns Vpds/Vpwf/Vpec and the WF 3-D mean field are forbidden as truth inputs
nuisance_design_Z: five trace-free affine-shear columns r_i(n_x^2-n_z^2), r_i(n_y^2-n_z^2), 2r_i n_x n_y, 2r_i n_x n_z, 2r_i n_y n_z
prospectively frozen PR-144 method/calibration and angular-selection templates
estimator.covariance: C=C_measurement+C_correlated_flow, using the full model-conditional covariance and forward-mock coverage; diagonal/noise-only covariance cannot authorize a result
estimator.formula: P_Z=Z(Z^T C^-1 Z)^-1 Z^T C^-1; g_perp=(I-P_Z)g; theta_hat=(g_perp^T C^-1 y)/(g_perp^T C^-1 g); Var(theta_hat)=1/(g_perp^T C^-1 g) when C and distances are fixed
estimator.distance_error_policy: catalogue distances enter both y and g, so uncertainty and bias must be calibrated with the PR-146 lognormal distance, nonlinear scatter, Malmquist selection, grouping, and correlated-flow forward mocks; naive fixed-design standard errors alone are insufficient
identifiability_gates: H_ref is fixed externally and byte-recorded
rank([Z,g]) equals its column count under relative SVD tolerance 1e-10
whitened smallest/largest singular-value ratio is at least 1e-8
residual information fraction (g_perp^T C^-1 g_perp)/(g^T C^-1 g) is at least 0.05
all preregistered windows pass independently; no borrowing from a passing scale

structural_distinctions.bulk_translation: angular dipole n.B, independent of r in the affine model
structural_distinctions.thin_shell_failure: if r is effectively constant, r/3 is collinear with M and theta is not identified
structural_distinctions.selection_warning: partial sky and depth-dependent selection can couple all three columns; structural distinction is not immunity

scalar_apex_firewall.finding: theta is a scalar trace of the velocity gradient and has no apex or sky axis
scalar_apex_firewall.consequence: a nonzero bulk-flow dipole can coexist with theta=0 (rigid translation), and Eq. 13 cannot align or compare theta to a q-dipole vector
scalar_apex_firewall.required_extra_authority: two preregistered q-summary response bridges R_lh_qs1(lambda,mask,frame) and R_lh_qs2(lambda,mask,frame), each derived by signed injections through the actual q likelihood and including the observer/window geometry and a defined scalar contrast

rules: R_lh_qs1 and R_lh_qs2 are separate calibrated response objects; neither may be silently set to one or copied from the other
the bridges map the signed scalar Delta_q_theta into prospectively defined scalar q summaries only; they do not create an apex
a missing or failed bridge makes only that summary branch unavailable, but any requested joint s1/s2 verdict remains NON_INFORMATIVE

scalar_apex_firewall.kill: if the q product is only a vector dipole/apex and no scalar-theta-to-q response is authenticated, terminate NON_INFORMATIVE_Q_RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE

injection_and_uncertainty_design.seed_rule: PCG64 seed 176000 plus the frozen scenario index; common random numbers across paired full/noise-only evaluations, independent streams across scenario families
scenarios: pure signed dilation theta in {-6,-3,0,3,6} km/s/Mpc
pure rigid translations of 100, 300, and 600 km/s in frozen Cartesian directions
lognormal distance-modulus error, nonlinear scatter, magnitude-limited/Malmquist selection, intra-group dispersion, and correlated-flow mocks inherited from PR-146
north/south, zone-of-avoidance, and method-composition selection perturbations frozen from PR-144
q-channel signed Delta_q injections through the actual q likelihood to estimate R_q and its mask/frame dependence
pass_gates: absolute mean bias below 0.1 reported standard deviations in every primary scenario
95 percent interval coverage point estimate between 0.93 and 0.97 and Wilson interval contains 0.95
pure translation, monopole, and shear each have theta false-positive rate at most 0.06 at nominal alpha=0.05
q response slope is within [0.9,1.1], response intercept magnitude below 0.1 q-channel standard deviations, and both signs are recovered
full covariance covers while any failure under realistic stressors is reported and blocks the affected window
injection_and_uncertainty_design.near_rigid_kill: if the residual-information gate fails, translation-only leakage exceeds 0.1 sigma, or the 5 percent false-positive gate fails, the divergence channel is NON_INFORMATIVE_NEAR_RIGID_OR_SELECTION_LEAKAGE

dependence_bound.matched_contrast: For j in {s1,s2}, D_(lambda,j)=q_hat_(lambda,j)-R_lh_qj(lambda) K_lambda theta_hat_lambda, where K_lambda=(1/9)[c/(H_ref lambda)]^2/H_ref
dependence_bound.unknown_cross_covariance: For marginal standard errors s_qj and s_theta, Cauchy-Schwarz gives sd(D_(lambda,j))<=s_qj+|R_lh_qj K_lambda|s_theta. The least-favourable two-sided interval is D_(lambda,j) +/- z_(1-alpha/(2m))[s_qj+|R_lh_qj K_lambda|s_theta], with m=6 frozen scale-summary contrasts (3 scales times s1/s2) and Bonferroni family control valid under arbitrary dependence.
dependence_bound.vector_generalization: for every preregistered scalar contrast a, the variance bound is [sqrt(a^T V_q a)+sqrt(a^T R_q K V_theta K^T R_q^T a)]^2; optimizing the contrast after outputs is forbidden
dependence_bound.allowed_pre_PR155_use: report channel-wise estimates, injections, and whether the least-favourable bound excludes zero; no joint likelihood, Bayes factor, combined sigma, apex agreement, or confirmation claim
dependence_bound.terminal_rule: even if the least-favourable diagnostic excludes zero, absent or invalid same-realization cross-channel covariance forces overall NON_INFORMATIVE_CROSS_CHANNEL_COVARIANCE_UNIDENTIFIED
dependence_bound.valid_joint_covariance_requirement: same realization IDs, same mask/window/frame/H_ref, full block covariance positive semidefinite, effective-rank and Monte Carlo error receipts, and independent mutation tests for shuffled or duplicated lineage

falsifiers.condition: H_ref is estimated from the same radial data, differs across channels, or is not hash-pinned
rank, condition, or residual-information gate fails, including thin-shell monopole collinearity
pure or near-rigid translation produces material theta or excess false positives
selection, calibration, Malmquist, grouping, or distance-error injections fail coverage/bias gates
Mpc/h enters the physical derivative without conversion or radial velocities/positions use mismatched frames
no authenticated scalar q response exists, only a q-dipole/apex is available, or signed q injections fail
joint covariance is unavailable, non-PSD, mismatched in realization lineage, or Monte Carlo unresolved
the linear sub-horizon almost-FLRW equation is applied outside its registered domain or described as an exact observational transfer

terminal_decision_tree: 2. Else if divergence rank/information or injection coverage fails: NON_INFORMATIVE_DIVERGENCE_CHANNEL.
3. Else report theta_hat and conditional Delta_q_theta separately at all frozen scales.
4. If authenticated signed q response R_q is unavailable or fails injection: NON_INFORMATIVE_Q_RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE.

5. Else compute the preregistered least-favourable dependence interval. If the valid same-realization joint covariance is absent or invalid: terminal NON_INFORMATIVE_CROSS_CHANNEL_COVARIANCE_UNIDENTIFIED, regardless of the marginal pattern.

6. Only with valid R_q and joint covariance: if the prospectively corrected discrepancy excludes zero, emit CONDITIONAL_CROSS_CHANNEL_FALSIFIER; otherwise emit NOT_FALSIFIED_AT_CURRENT_RESOLUTION. Neither branch is confirmation, detection, global acceleration, or geometry/family evidence.

numerical_scratch_receipt.fixture: 1200 random sky directions, radii uniform on 75..125 Mpc, nuisance basis B+constant-monopole+five STF shear columns
numerical_scratch_receipt.interpretation: The algebraic fixture confirms structural separation when radial leverage exists and exact monopole/divergence non-identification on a thin shell. It is a design proof only, not observational validation.

tools_and_commands.network_note: The browser-backed primary-source route succeeded. A direct shell curl of the arXiv TeX source was unavailable due sandbox DNS and the escalation was rejected for account usage limits; no workaround or unregistered source was used.

remaining_risks: The frozen numerical scale/window choices still require the main writer to verify adequate authenticated CF4 support without looking at PR-176 outputs.
The raw radial estimator is exactly conditional on H_ref; no internal statistic can remove that degeneracy.
The Tsagas scalar map does not by itself define the q-dipole response or its apex.
PR-146 off-diagonal correlated-flow covariance is model-conditional rather than independently physically validated.
No observed PR-176 rank, theta, Delta_q, q response, or cross-channel verdict has been computed in this assignment.
